purpose: Native charge-aware manual injection, Cunningham Stokes drag, Coulomb force, force reversal, native parcel IO and restart in all three solvers

configuration.injection: manualInjection; parcelCharge +/-1 or0; U0(0 0 0); fixed diameter10nm; nParticle1
configuration.carrier: U0; constant frozen T,p,rho,composition; chemistry, energy, flow and electrostatic solve disabled; parcels active

variants.restart: continuous positive run compared to two-stage .00025+.00025 run
variants.missingE: RC/CHT force-on case must report missing prescribed E; MR creates E from its electrostatic state and is excluded from this negative configuration test

nativeEvidence: ASCII lagrangian/reactingCloud1/{positions,U,chargeNumber,d} at checkpoint and final time. No custom diagnostics are required.
results: evidence/results.json aggregates the latest completed per-solver case acceptance records; each case retains native outputs and logs; previous runs are archived under evidence/prior_runs.
